items.title: HDI Global secures Lloyd’s underwriting permission for Syndicate 2029
items.summary: Syndicate 2029 is set to begin writing 13 specialty lines on January 1 following final regulatory approval.

items.title: GSK and Moderna settle patent lawsuits over vaccines and RSV shots
items.summary: GSK and Moderna have resolved international patent litigation regarding mRNA delivery technology without financial penalties.

items.title: Bank of England deputy warns UK youth bear brunt of low-gear economy
items.summary: Clare Lombardelli highlights a slowdown in entry-level hiring and signals a live December interest rate decision amid geopolitical supply pressures.

items.title: Young workers face pension blind spots as early saving power is highlighted
items.summary: Research reveals widespread anxiety over pension literacy as industry figures urge early engagement to harness compound growth.

items.title: Poundland insolvency risk exposes trade credit insurance blind spots
items.summary: Credit insurers withdrew cover months before Poundland faced administration, leaving unsecured suppliers exposed as retail insolvencies rise.

items.title: CFC and Carrick Group announce executive appointments
items.summary: Specialist insurer CFC and Bermuda legacy insurer Carrick Group have announced executive appointments across their people, operations and commercial leadership teams.
